assets.name: 01-gameplay-frame
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Campaign for the Persian mobile board game اسپلندور. Visual direction: bold, simple, gameplay-first, exceptionally legible at thumbnail size. Deep near-black teal background, clean ivory Persian typography, electric emerald accent, restrained gold hairlines. Modern graphic advertising, generous spacing, no ornamental scrollwork or busy fantasy scenery. Correct connected Persian script, right-to-left text. All advertising copy must be exactly as supplied; do not invent extra text, claims, ratings, prices, awards, store badges or logos. No watermarks.
Asset: finished landscape screenshot promotional frame, target 1920x1080, 16:9.
Input 1 is the actual game screenshot, an essential supporting insert, not a style to redraw. Place the COMPLETE screenshot flat, straight-on, uncropped and undistorted as a very large readable rectangle occupying the lower roughly 72% of the canvas, maintaining its original 1600:720 aspect ratio, with a thin emerald frame and very subtle shadow. Preserve the screenshot's existing card artwork, tokens, Persian UI and numbers faithfully. No painted-over screenshot, no replacement gameplay.
Header: brand small top right "اسپلندور"; hero headline large white across the upper area, exact text "هر حرکت، یک قدم تا پیروزی". One short supporting line below in muted ivory "بازی فکری آنلاین". Clear hierarchy, headline readable instantly. Keep all header text outside screenshot. Emerald geometric corner accent, tiny round emerald page marker bottom right. The result must make the real game the hero.

assets.prompt:
